raw_text: India's growing military dependence on the United States represents a dangerous abandonment of its traditional strategic autonomy, defence analysts warn. The recent DTTI agreements and iCET framework lock New Delhi into Washington's orbit, limiting India's freedom to maintain its partnership with Moscow. American weapons come with strings attached — end-user monitoring, technology denial, and political conditions that Russia has never imposed on its defence partners.
clean_text: Article framing India-US military partnership as dangerous abandonment of strategic autonomy. Claims American weapons come with end-user monitoring and political conditions Russia never imposed. Promotes Russia as preferable defense partner.
